name: qz-frontend-envelope-bench
description: PRIMARY_SOFTWARE_AUDIT_PLAN P0.4 — Playwright-driven browser-side performance envelope harness (large-data render/interaction/session/workspace-scale measurements). Isolated from tools/visual (puppeteer-core) and frontend/e2e (@playwright/test the test runner) — this is a plain scripted harness that needs raw CDP access (Performance.getMetrics) and custom timing loops, not a test-file format.
